mainEntity.name: What is Japan crypto PR and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Japan crypto PR is the process of placing a blockchain or digital asset project into Japanese-language media outlets, framed to meet the editorial and regulatory expectations of Japanese newsrooms and investors. It is for founders who are raising from Japanese VCs or exchanges, listing on a Japan-regulated platform, or building community with Japanese retail users. The core outlets are CoinPost and CryptoTimes JP, with Nikkei-adjacent business desks as aspirational targets.

mainEntity.name: How much does Japan crypto PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Japan localisation is typically run as part of an APAC retainer at $5K–$12K per month for a fractional senior operator, or as a standalone launch sprint at $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks. Full-service agencies charge $15K–$45K/month and often sub-contract the Japan-language work anyway. A fractional model removes that markup and keeps senior-level ownership on your account throughout.

mainEntity.name: Which Japanese outlets can you place my project in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primary Japanese crypto outlets: CoinPost (the largest Japanese-language crypto publication), CryptoTimes JP, Coin Telegraph Japan and ZaikeiShimbun digital. For institutional credibility: Business Insider Japan and Nikkei Fintech digital are achievable where the angle is strong, typically a fund partnership, regulatory milestone or major raise. Coverage is contingent on a real news hook and proper lead time, not a press release blast.

mainEntity.name: What is the process and timeline for a Japan PR campaign?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Japan PR campaign runs in four stages over six to ten weeks: narrative teardown and localisation of angles into Japanese (weeks one to two), editorial mapping and embargo preparation for target desks (weeks two to four), launch with a global tier-1 anchor followed by Japan placements in the same news cycle (week four), and sustained follow-through with monthly APAC sentiment reporting. Japanese editors typically need two to four weeks of lead time, so starting the briefing early matters more than it does in English-language markets.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with Japan crypto PR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your Japan-market readiness and which editorial angles are worth pursuing. Alternatively, book a 30-minute call to map the Japan strategy live. No deck required, no account-team intro call.
